pages.title: OGEN — Emergency Response Dashboard | Mika Drori
pages.description: OGEN is a tablet system for Population NCOs at disaster sites, turning fragmented field data into a clear map of trapped individuals. UX UI and complex dashboard design.
pages.headline: OGEN
pages.subtitle: Emergency response system for disaster sites
pages.body: Designing a digital complex content product that organizes and delivers heavy data through intuitive UX, clear information architecture, and a refined visual system. OGEN is a tablet-based system designed for Population NCOs at disaster sites. It helps manage order within chaos, organizes incoming field data in real time, and gives rescuers an accurate map of trapped individuals to save lives.
